item.title: Navy ‘Doomsday Plane’ Fleet To Almost Double In Size With New E-130Js
item.summary: A much bigger fleet of smaller turboprop E-130Js is set to replace the smaller fleet of larger E-6B jets, but the Navy has also acknowledged risks. The post Navy ‘Doomsday Plane’ Fleet To Almost Double In Size With New E-130Js appeared first on TWZ .
